name: card
purpose: Displays content or metadata in the UI. Lives at `packages/webkit/src/components/content/card/`.
useWhen: Group related console content into one bordered surface with a title header, a body and an optional footer, such as a settings block, a summary or a form section.
Host a divided list edge to edge: set `:padded="false"` and put an `Item` list in the `content` slot.
A centered single-card screen (sign-up, onboarding, a success page) that needs header, body and footer regions.
A catalog tile for an integration, an extension or a plugin: set `kind="integration"` for the logo, the name, the vendor, a short description, badges, the installed state and one action.
avoidWhen: The surface sits above the page as a modal or a side sheet → use `dialog` or `drawer`.
It is one tier of a pricing comparison → use `card-pricing`.
It is a framed cell or band of a marketing page → use `frame-box` or `card-grid`.
It is a single row of title, description, media and actions → use `item`.
It is one record of a resource list shown as cards, with selection and fields → use `cards` (with `useCollection`).
It is a template tile in a gallery with no vendor, badge or install state → keep `kind="default"` with a `content` slot (see `platform/view/template-browser`).
related: item` — rows inside the card; with `padded` set to false, an `Item` list runs its dividers to the card edges.
card-pricing` — pricing tier card with its own price hierarchy and action.
card-grid` — responsive grid of cells for marketing pages.
panel` — the layered shell behind overlays, not an in-page card.
empty-state` — goes in the `content` slot when the card has no data yet.
bestPractices: Put the body in the `content` slot. There is no `default` slot, so children passed without `#content` don't render.
Use `title` for a plain heading (rendered as an `h2`). Use the `header` slot only when the header needs another layout: it replaces both the title and `header-action`.
header-action` content stays hidden until the header is hovered or focused, so keep it to secondary actions and never make it the only way to reach a control.
Set `:padded="false"` only when the content draws its own inset or needs flush dividers.
The footer renders only when the `footer` slot has content; don't pass an empty template to reserve space.

kind="integration"` lays the card out from props: `title`, `logo` (or the `logo` slot), `vendor`, `description`, `badges` and `installed`. The title becomes a link when `href` is set, otherwise a button that emits `select`, and it stretches over the whole card so the tile is one target. Put a single action (Install, Configure) in the `action` slot; it sits above the stretched target and stays reachable on its own.
Keep the description to one or two sentences; the card clamps it to three lines.
Show at most two badges (category, context, plan). The installed state is a prop, not a badge, so it reads the same everywhere.
Integration cards sit under a section heading, so their title is an `h3`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Heading rendered in the header when the `header` slot is empty; with `kind="integration"`, the item name.

props.name: padded
props.doc: Pads the content region. Set `false` for flush, edge-to-edge content such as an `ItemList` with full-width dividers.

props.name: kind
props.doc: integration` lays the card out as a catalog tile from `title`, `logo`, `vendor`, `description`, `badges`, `installed` and the `action` slot.

props.name: logo
props.doc: Integration kind: icon class for the logo mark. The `logo` slot takes an image instead.

props.name: vendor
props.doc: Integration kind: who publishes the item, shown as "by {vendor}".

props.name: description
props.doc: Integration kind: one or two sentences on what the item does.

props.name: badges
props.doc: Integration kind: small tags such as the category or the context (`{ label, severity? }`, severity defaults to `info`).

props.name: installed
props.doc: Integration kind: shows the Installed tag.

props.name: href
props.doc: Integration kind: the title links here; without it the title is a button that emits `select`.

events.name: select
events.notes: Integration kind without `href`: the title (the whole tile) was activated.

slots.name: header
slots.notes: Replaces the default header layout (title + header-action).

slots.name: header-action
slots.notes: Actions aligned to the end of the default header; visible on header hover.

slots.name: content
slots.notes: Main card body; with `kind="integration"` it renders under the description.

slots.name: footer
slots.notes: Footer actions or metadata; omitted when empty.

slots.name: logo
slots.notes: Integration kind: replaces the logo mark, for an `img` with an empty `alt`.

slots.name: action
slots.notes: Integration kind: one action at the end of the tile, above the stretched title target.
